title: Markup written directly into the document (javascript)
description: The script writes markup with document.write. The string is parsed as HTML in the current document, so any interpolated value becomes markup — including an event handler or a script element that the original page never contained.
remediation: Build nodes with the DOM API and assign text, for example createElement with textContent, so values are never parsed as markup.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the write without tracing the interpolated value.
